newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: RTRS-Cricket: Rain delays Australia v India match.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket: Rain delays Australia v India match.

text.p: A heavy early morning shower has delayed the start of Australia's vital Singer World Series encounter with India in Colombo.
Officials told reporters the match -- with the winners going on to face World Cup champions and hosts Sri Lanka in Saturday's final -- would be staged on Friday if play was abandoned.
Australia easily won their first match of the quadrangular tournament against Zimbabwe last week before suffering a heavy defeat by Sri Lanka on Monday.
Pace bowler Paul Reiffel has been added to Australia's 12-man squad. Captain and wicketkeeper Ian Healy has not yet named his starting line-up to face India.
